WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
    AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
), mix_averages AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_mix_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.instownpct) AS avg_ownership,
  AVG(m.instownpct / NULLIF(x.avg_mix_ownership, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_mix,
  AVG(m.instownpct - o.avg_ownership) AS avg_excess_overall
FROM matched AS m
JOIN mix_averages AS x ON x.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership;
